lines.text: Zedekiah became king at twenty-one, reigned eleven years in Jerusalem, did evil, and rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem, famine struck, and after the city was breached the men of war fled by night.
The Chaldeans overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and at Damascus the king of Babylon killed his sons.
Nebuzaradan entered Jerusalem, burned the house of the LORD, and the Chaldeans carried the bronze pillars and the bronze Sea to Babylon.
Evil-merodach pardoned Jehoiachin and released him from prison, and Jehoiachin dined at the king's table for the rest of his life in Nineveh.
